title: Survey Italianen 1986-1987
authors: Beukenhorst, D.J., Pennings, T., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Antropologisch-sociologisch centrum (primary investigator)
contributors: Ministerie van binnenlandse zaken * Den Haag (research initiator)
descriptions: Circumstances in which Italians live in the Netherlands. Residence in Italy in the past / possessions in Italy / occupation before moving to the Netherlands / migration history / number of years of residence in the Netherlands / Italian family or acquaintances at arrival in the Netherlands / housing situation / plans ( and reasons ) for moving / detailed account of work( situation ). Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
